question: With what inner attitude and to whom should offerings be presented after worship?
premises: Worship is performed with an attitude of devotion.
The act of worship is completed first.
The offering is then to be presented to virgins.
inference: After worshipping with devotion, one should offer to the virgins.
uncertainties: What is to be offered is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Having worshipped with an attitude of devotion, one should make the offering to the virgins.
